text: Competing on her 35th birthday, Francesca Lollobrigida powered to victory in the women’s speed skating 3000m to deliver Italy’s first gold medal of Milano Cortina 2026 in a new Olympic record time of 3:54.28. Weeks after admitting she had been on the verge of quitting the sport due to a viral infection, the mother of one called it “the dream of the dream” — a victory that ignited the Games for the host nation.
